title: Apartment Interior Design 115 m² in Vienna | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 115 m² apartment in Vienna: interior design, 3D visualization, technical drawings, custom furniture and turnkey renovation.
h1: Apartment interior design in Vienna, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 115 m²

blocks.text: Apartment interior design in Vienna, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 115 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN completed a comprehensive project for a 115 m² apartment in Vienna, Austria — from developing the interior design and technical documentation to manufacturing custom furniture and carrying out a turnkey renovation.
The design covers the living room, bedroom, kitchen, walk-in closets, entrance hall, and bathroom, including built-in wardrobes, shelving, and storage systems.
The wardrobes, storage systems, and kitchen with built-in appliances were custom-made and designed alongside the interior — tailored to the architecture of this particular apartment.

Before work began, a detailed cost estimate was prepared covering construction and finishing work, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting. A turnkey renovation of the apartment was then carried out according to the technical documentation.
Below are 3D visualizations and photos of the finished apartment, so you can compare the concept with the result.
